intent: Development-only deterministic suppression ablation on previously unscored v9 records
cohort_rule: Require exact old prefix, accept only later records with timestamp beyond old cutoff, and exclude every generation present in old post-v9 cohort. Reset tracker on every generation change or missing depth4 endpoint. No truth-selected inclusion.

arms.name: adjacent_cell_max
arms.suppression: Retain a candidate iff no higher-priority original candidate lies within one delay bin AND one base-CPI Doppler bin, both inclusive with 1e-9 numerical tolerance.
arms.rationale: Minimal immediate CAF-cell duplicate suppression; no truth-derived scale.

arms.name: configured_centroid_max
arms.suppression: Retain a candidate iff no higher-priority original candidate lies strictly within the configured native centroid rectangle.
arms.rationale: Existing nCentroid=6 at 2MHz reference scales by ceil(6*6144000/2000000)=19 delay bins; Doppler remains six base-CPI bins. Matches production Centroid local-max geometry for unequal SNR, with deterministic equal-SNR tie handling.

suppression_semantics: Compare every candidate against the complete original list, not only retained winners. Preserve original output order, original values and full support lineage. Suppression does not interpolate or average.

evaluation.control_policy: No wrap, no generation crossing, nearest within 0.6 seconds; exclude shifted truth within twice the gate of current truth. Controls remain dependent sensitivity analyses.
evaluation.minimum_episode_reporting: Separate >=4 endpoint confirmation eligibility and >=20 endpoint nominal 80-base-CPI lifetime floor; no whole-pass claim.
